name: Robbie Brody
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: His campaign says he chairs Burbank's Parks and Recreation board and previously chaired the city's Water & Power and Art in Public Places boards. He is an administrative law judge, a role his campaign says he has held in Pasadena for 24 years.

sentences.text: His campaign says he chairs Burbank's Parks and Recreation board and previously chaired the city's Water & Power and Art in Public Places boards.
He is an administrative law judge, a role his campaign says he has held in Pasadena for 24 years.

items.text: His campaign says he would preserve neighborhood character, cut red tape for small businesses, and support housing young families can afford. At a candidate forum, he called the city's police surveillance cameras a "warrantless search of people who have not done anything wrong." He urged safeguards like limited use and shorter data retention. He told the Los Angeles Daily News he would hold quarterly town halls and publish plain-language vote explanations.
